The '''LR1K sonic cannon''', also known as the '''Geonosian sonic cannon''' or the '''Geonosian defense platform''', was a high-powered artillery emplacement weapon produced by the [[Gordarl Weaponsmiths/Legends|Gordarl Weaponsmiths]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Description==
[[File:LR1KSonicCannon-LaPR.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A sonic cannon being fired at the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Second Battle of Geonosis]]]]
The LR1K cannon used [[Sonic blaster/Legends|sonic blaster]] technology that employed internal oscillators to produce a devastating sonic blast. The high-impact concussive sonic energy was stabilized by a containment sphere within the cannon until impact against a target, at which point it broke up to create an omnidirectional blast. Commonly, the LR1K required two [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] or [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] gunners to operate, although the cannon's advanced, highly precise targeting computers could do most of the work. A critical hit with this weapon would instantly kill any average clone.

==History==
Four cannons were deployed against a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] strike team in the [[Petranaki arena]], and many others were later deployed during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]] against invading [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on the planet's dusty plains.<ref name="SWE2">{{Film|II}}</ref> They were later used to defend Geonosis against the Republic's [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|second planetary invasion]].<ref name="LPR">{{TCW|Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> Several of the sonic cannons were deployed to defend [[Mining/Legends|mines]] on the planet [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Gauntlet">{{StoryCite|story=The Gauntlet of Death|book=Free Comic Book Day 2009 Special|sformatted=''The Gauntlet of Death''|smanual=1}}</ref>

[[File:Geonosianblaster.jpg|thumb|right|220px|An LR1K deployed in the Petranaki arena]]

==Behind the scenes==
The sonic cannon first appeared with the release of [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. They were computer generated.
